name: computer
description: Control Mac apps through an open accessibility adapter, with a confirmation policy for risky actions. Tools are list_apps, get_app_state, get_state, open_app, click, type_text, and press_key. Computer execution in the seed is dry-run unless the Mac adapter is on, so a dry-run result means no app was touched. Transcript: before the first tool call in a turn, say in one plain sentence what you are about to do. After a successful open, answer in one sentence naming the app, the site, and the URL as a link, and stop. Do not dump tool result JSON, and do not call more tools after success.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List apps available to the computer adapter.

tools.name: get_app_state
tools.description: Get the current state for an app, without touching it.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Get the current computer state: mode, running apps, and Chrome tabs if the debugging port is reachable, else tabs unavailable with the port instruction.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open a Mac app by name. In dry-run mode this records only, no app is opened.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click at screen coordinates x and y in a Mac app. Do not guess coordinates. Only click when the user gave x and y, or an element list gave coordinates. Never invent coordinates such as 100, 100. Requires confirmation for risky targets, and needs Accessibility permission in Mac mode.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into a Mac app. Typing alone does not submit anything. To submit a typed URL or form field, call press_key with key Enter after typing. Press Enter once only, then read the state in the press_key result and answer in one sentence. Do not press Enter again for the same URL. Sensitive data transmission requires pre-approval or confirmation, and the text is never logged.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press one key in a Mac app, after activating it. Use Enter to submit a typed URL or form field. Press Enter once only, then read the state in the result, then answer in one sentence. Do not press Enter again for the same URL, and do not call get_state or get_app_state again after that state is already in the result. Allowed keys are Enter, Escape, Tab, Space, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, and ArrowRight.
